content:
maya: Quick sync — proposing a geofence-first rollout for the new routing policy. Need to lock launch gates and fallback rules. TL;DR: canary in 1 geo -> broaden -> global. Thoughts?

samir: 👍 what's the initial canary % and metrics we watch?

maya: start 5% in CA-west geofence (internal name: geofence-1). Monitor p95 latency, error-rate, and model-quality regression on key prompts.

jordan: can we define hard abort thresholds? error-rate > 1% for 10min or p95 increase > 25% for 5min? Also spike in user-facing reroutes.

alex: propose config snippet:
```
flag: routing_geofence_v1
variants:
  - stable: 0
  - canary: 5
rules:
  - region: geofence-1
    rollout: 5
    priority: high
fallback:
  - to: routing_legacy
    conditions:
      - error_rate > 1%
      - p95_latency > baseline * 1.25
```

maya: love that. add a soft rollback: auto-decrease to 1% if issues seen, and open a page for SRE.

priya: add customer impact gate — if any VIP customers hit errors, immediate pause. Also record evaluation set pass rate >= 98%.

samir: SRE will own the abort automation. I'll wire alerts: `canary/error_rate`, `canary/p95_rel`, `canary/quality_regression` to the runbook.

deploy-bot: canary deploy started: routing_geofence_v1 @ 05% -> geofence-1 (1901239899)

alex: note: A/B cohort assignment must be sticky and preserve session routing for 30m to avoid churn.

maya: final asks before we ship: 1) confirm abort thresholds in doc, 2) add customer whitelist/blacklist toggle, 3) schedule 30m post-canary healthy check with PM + SRE.

jordan: I can take (1) and (3). samir will add alert bindings. priya will prep customer whitelist.

maya: thanks all — moving to rollout checklist and tagging infra + legal for the geofence compliance signoff.
